items.title: Add C# SDK names for administration and private endpoint status
items.summary: Adds C#-specific client names for the new HorizonDB administrator client and models and for the new private endpoint updateStatus operation. These customizations do not alter the REST contract or an existing language-neutral SDK surface.

inferenceResults.rationale: The C# client name targets the newly added updateStatus operation; it does not rename an existing language-neutral method or change REST.
The C# client names apply to newly introduced administrator client and model declarations, so no existing generated contract is displaced.
